quarterly_data.signal: Tenstorrent's stated operating plan: it will deploy Galaxy servers at scale, continue serving open-weight models across LLMs and video generation, and advance the AI and CPU IP it licenses to customers designing their own silicon. The company says it sells AI compute at every level of the stack, from a single card or workstation to racks, superclusters and custom IP, with an open-source software stack for running models locally and on-prem. CEO Jim Keller: 'We built one architecture and sell it at every size.'
